 Ngernturbo PCL (TURBO): Opportunity Day for YE’20252026 Strategic & Financial Outlook: Key Value Drivers
● Quality Portfolio Growth & Steady Yields: Targeting 15 –25% loan growth in 2026 via optimized LTVs and quality 
customer acquisition. Yields projected to hold steady.
● Improving Asset Quality: Credit costs expected to decline over the next 18 –24 months, driven by rigorous initial 
underwriting and enhanced collection efficiency.
● Accelerating Insurance Expansion: Non-life brokerage scaling to consistently outpace loan growth over the next 36 
months, diversifying revenue.
● Enhancing Operational Efficiency: Significant decline expected in the cost -to-income ratio. While absolute OPEX will be 
slightly elevated, its growth will be well below revenue increases, driven by scale and AI integration.
● Optimizing Cost of Funds: Funding costs expected to stabilize or decline further —even with the planned 2H shareholder 
loan repayment —benefiting from post -IPO credit upgrades, expanded facilities, and policy rate cuts.
● Expanding Profitability: Targeted Return on Assets (ROA) improvement of 75 –125 bps, fueled by the combined impact of 
operational efficiencies, lower credit costs, and optimized funding.
*IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER: The above financial targets may change depending on economic conditions and do not include the impact of any future business opportunities.
